full_page.content:
1934, August
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
Page 218 Cont.
Aug. 27 John Coneff (one-time successful insurance and business- man .... founder of the"Cath'c Beneficial Society.") wonders where he'l get $175 to pay monthly rental ... Raised $300.00 six yrs ago on house- furniture - at 32% per month. = 42% per annum! (gave him 30c for Gass) and supply of bread.
28 Same J. C. brings most promising letter perporting to invite him to be partner with millionaire.
Blank Page
1934, September
Page 219 Page 220 Sep. 2nd Donald Herman - 7 - colds and mastoids - fears the cold on ac- count of fearful pains - had only about 30 day in school last year - Doc'ors want-very bright boy - big enough for 10 yr. Mother promises $5 p. month for yr.
Mrs. Ames, 3 yrs widdow has 5 small child'n. Threatened with in- ward cancer (colon) Drs. want to operate ... promises 100. Enrol- Iments to Poor Souls if operation be averted. Started Aug. 21 - $4.00. - Sep. 25 $50 donation finished To-day for Poor Souls, Mrs. C. Ames thinks she's cured. See Aug. 17-26.
D. J. Healy ... III - 20 - Hay-fever .. . Vocation
Dr. Weisner .. wants new place ... Mrs. Clara Czyzewska - 31 - Husband & little girl of 9 Mrs. Jane Taylor - 64 - inward Cancer James Casey (Brother) - 70 of Seattle .... Cancer
Workless. .
Fr. Hunt
Page 221 Blank Page Page 222 Sep. 5 Mrs. Peters - 66 - cancer of foot ... coming O.K.
Mrs. John (Anne) Gorman - 38 - Trained nurse - married and praying for six yrs. - doctoring ... all in vain - no hope left ... Enrolls in Seraph. Mass Ass'n in April for that intention - promising poor souls enrollment every - In following May noticed happy indication of answer to prayer - now four months to "goal".
